title: Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Wall-Mounted W/ Gallery Rail, Solid Brass | Golden Yellow | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Organize toiletries where you need them—this wall-mounted double glass shelf keeps bottles and daily bathroom essentials off the counter while staying easy to reach in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality. This glass shelf works as a bathroom shelf and wall shelf, with a gallery rail designed to keep your items in place.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for everyday bathroom use—3/8-Inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
- Strong, coordinating hardware—solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting for a clean look
- Designed to match—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces and transitional bath accessories / transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall-mounted glass shelf (bathroom shelf / wall shelf)
- Shelf glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
- Overall dimensions: 22 in L x 5 in projection x 8 in H
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-Inch), tempered
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging; concealed screw mounting
- Assembly required: false
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4"
